strings.sync.label: Cloud save: {status}
strings.sync.sheet.title: Cloud save
strings.sync.sheet.local: Your progress lives on this device. It saves online once you're connected.
strings.sync.sheet.synced.guest: Your progress is saved online as a guest game. Clearing your browser data wipes it: create an account to keep it.
strings.sync.sheet.synced.account: Your progress is saved to your account game. Log in on any device to pick it back up.
strings.sync.sheet.offline: No connection. Keep playing: your progress is saved on this device and goes to your account game when you're back online.
strings.sync.sheet.paused: Saving to your account game is paused because the server could not accept this save. Keep playing on this device; we'll try again later.
strings.sync.sheet.update: Your account game was saved by a newer version of the game. Reload to update, then saving picks back up.
strings.sync.sheet.behind: This device's game is from before your last prestige, so it can't replace your account game. Use your account game instead.
strings.sync.sheet.conflict: This device and your account game have different progress. Pick the one to keep. The other one is gone for good, and a guest game on this device can't be recovered after this.
strings.sync.sheet.conflictEmpty: This device has a game from another account. Keep it on this account, or start fresh here. The other one is gone for good.
strings.sync.sheet.signedOut: You signed out, so this device isn't saving to an account. Log in from the Me tab to save again.
